meta.name: Auto-captions
meta.description: A talking clip captioned from its own audio: transcribed once on this machine, pinned as words, then drawn as boxed karaoke captions.
meta.creativeDirection: Direction: a vertical social clip where the voice drives the type. A short title card, then the talk with boxed captions in the lower third, legible over the footage, each spoken word turning yellow as it is said. Review: the highlight never runs ahead of the voice, no phrase exceeds two lines, captions stay inside the platform safe zone.
